Company Overview 
 At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
 
 Department Overview 
○ International Services & Software
○ Our Department is providing technical support for the delivery of a major mission-critical operations system in the development and implementation of customer applications and company products for the customer’s best performance and success. 
Job Description
 We are seeking a Junior Software Developer who is passionate about technology and eager to learn. This entry-level position is designed for a recent graduate with foundational knowledge in software development principles and a strong desire to start their professional career. 
 
 Key Responsibilities
 Application Development: Write clean, efficient, well-documented, and scalable application in windows environment [e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript]. 

 Feature Implementation: Assist in the development and implementation of new features, modules, and services across our platform. 

 Testing and Debugging: Participate in unit, integration, and system testing. Identify and resolve software defects and bugs. 

 Collaboration: Work within an Agile/Scrum framework, participating in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives. 

 Code Review: Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and share knowledge. 

 Documentation: Assist in creating and maintaining technical documentation, design specifications, and user guides. 

 Learning and Growth: Proactively seek out new technologies, tools, and methodologies to improve skills and processes. 

 
 #LI-WL1
 
Basic Requirements
 Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field completed within the last 12-18 months. Fresh Graduates are welcome to apply! 

 Programming Skills: Foundational knowledge and experience in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Java, Python, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript ). 

 Core Concepts: Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) , data structures, algorithms, and software development lifecycle principles. 

 Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. 

 Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills and a desire to work in a team-based environment. 

 Tools: Familiarity with version control systems, particularly Git . 

 This role required travelling to Asia,Middle East and Africa regions 

 Knowledge on AI and Big Data 

 
 (Bonus) Qualifications
 Experience with web development frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Spring Boot, Django). 

 Knowledge of database technologies (e.g., SQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB). 

 Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP ) or containerization tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). 

 Completed relevant personal projects, internships, or open-source contributions. 

 Developing AI tools 

 Cybersecurity 

 
Travel Requirements
Under 10% 
Relocation Provided
None 
Position Type
Experienced 
 Referral Payment Plan
No 
 EEO Statement 
 
 Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.  
 
 We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.
